newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS sets up S$140.0 mln finance for MCL.
newsitem.headline: DBS sets up S$140.0 mln finance for MCL.

text.p: Development Bank of Singapore Ltd (DBS) said on Wednesday it had arranged a Singapore $140.0 million financing package for a unit of MCL Land Ltd.

The funds were to be used to refinance land acquisition and development costs of a proposed S$215.0 million residential and commercial project at Robertson Quay in central Singapore, DBS said in a statement.
The package consists of a transferable loan facility of S$90.0 million, an embedded bond call option of S$90.0 million and a revolving credit facility of up to S$50.0 million.
The bond issue aimed to tap both private and sophisticated investment funds, DBS said.
